limitations: Only a particle initially launched rightward at the left wall is considered.
The exit-time variance, not the coefficient of variation or higher moments, is classified.
The excess left-wall release rate must be strictly positive and fixed while the bulk reversal rate varies.
The general generic-boundary first-passage Laplace-transform formalism is prior work; the claim is solely the exact variance phase classification and coalescence.
Numerical root evaluations are supporting evidence, not proofs of root count or novelty.
title: A sharp two-turning-point transition in run-and-tumble escape-time variance
